key.description: The translation key of the keybind (e.g. `"key.jump"`, `"key.attack"`). See [Key Names](https://0vergrown.github.io/Sync-Documentation-Website/?file=data_types/functional_key#key-names) below.
key.markdownDescription: The translation key of the keybind (e.g. `"key.jump"`, `"key.attack"`). See [Key Names](https://0vergrown.github.io/Sync-Documentation-Website/?file=data_types/functional_key#key-names) below.

continuous.description: If `true`, the key is considered pressed every tick it is held down; if `false`, it only fires once per press.
continuous.markdownDescription: If `true`, the key is considered pressed every tick it is held down; if `false`, it only fires once per press.

action.description: The action to execute on the player when the key is pressed (or held, if continuous).
action.markdownDescription: The action to execute on the player when the key is pressed (or held, if continuous).
